description: R08 KeyBindings family checkpoint: safe Rust closes all seventeen Microsoft KeyBindingsTests contracts. Fifteen are Exact; KeyChords and LayerScancodeKeybindings are Partial only for their active Windows keyboard-layout mapping boundary.

entries.notes: Rust reproduces the portable serialization/parse vectors, modifier ordering, named plus, numeric vk(255), sc(123) preservation and KeyChord data model. The source method additionally derives the effective VKey for a raw scan code through active-layout MapVirtualKeyW; that platform lookup is intentionally not claimed by the safe Rust owner.
Multiple chords bind the same semantic action while retaining independent key-map entries and Microsoft's 0→1→2→4 cardinality sequence.
Later layers replace an existing effective chord without growing the key map; distinct chords remain additive.
Repeated identical splitPane command content deduplicates to one semantic action entry.
newTab default arguments and newTab(index=0) retain distinct semantic identities while preserving nullable profile-index semantics.
unbound, null, unknown command and numeric command values all become recoverable explicit unbinds while retaining the chord slot.

Rust reproduces Microsoft’s US-layout vector where scan code 41 and the grave key share one effective identity, including replacement/cardinality semantics. General scancode↔VKey/character equivalence still depends on the active Windows keyboard layout (MapVirtualKeyW/VkKeyScanW), so the source contract remains platform-boundary Partial.
Explicit-unbound state follows Microsoft's false→false→true→false bind/unbind/rebind transition.
Rust owns Microsoft's ten copy/newTab/adjustFontSize vectors, including defaults, unknown-copy-member tolerance, profile indexes 0/11 and signed font deltas.
vertical maps Right, horizontal maps Down, and omitted/auto map Automatic across all four Microsoft vectors.
Scalar keys syntax is accepted and simple copy exposes effective singleLine=false.
Rust preserves null/no-color defaults and converts #123456 to Microsoft's COLORREF byte order 0x563412.
Both scroll directions preserve nullable rowsToScroll, explicit value 10, and rejection of negative rows without mutating a fresh key map.
String/default/action launch modes resolve to Action, commandLine resolves to CommandLine, and invalid launchMode is rejected before binding.
forward/backward directions bind exactly; bare moveTab without required args is ignored; invalid direction is rejected.
Explicit IDs preserve bidirectional ID↔key lookup for simple, object-argument, new-terminal and commandPalette actions.
When scan code 255 has no VKey translation, effective identity falls back to the scan code and the explicit action remains retrievable.
